data.title: 爱夏·香料摊前的比较
data.action: 左手托起一只香料罐，右手把清单压在摊位边缘
data.description: 爱夏停在市集香料摊前，左手将一只小陶罐托到视线下方，右手把采购单压在木柜台边缘。旅行斗篷的兜帽垂在肩后，马尾和发带完整露出，挎包闭合。棚布投下柔和阴影，罐口与手背接住摊位外的日光；横幅背景以空置摊架、布幌和石墙交代市集。
data.promptProse: Beneath a striped market awning, Aisha lifts a small ceramic spice jar in her left palm and examines its contents. Her right hand pins a shopping slip against the wooden counter, and her closed cross-body satchel rests at her hip. The travel cloak hood lies behind her shoulders, leaving the ponytail and ribbon visible. A medium-wide view includes rows of jars along the counter; daylight catches their rims beneath the awning shade, with empty stall frames and stone walls beyond.
